finding: F2 selection record section 12.5 row 7; 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9
case: A grant that did not arrive, where the effect proceeds with less.
why: Section 12.5 row 7. The guarantee is GrantDeliveryReceipt's -- an executor whose grant did not arrive fails loudly and never completes with less -- and it is pinned on the edge that starts the executor, because section 12.4's thirty guard names are a closed list and this is not one of them. The mutation deletes the attestation conjunct and leaves the receipt reference demanded, so the instance still POINTS AT a receipt while nothing asserts the grant arrived.
